forum.content_text:
hello,

When using MDMA (STM32H753), and more than one transfer, the code generated doesn't align correctly the struct MDMA\_LinkNodeTypeDef. This structure should be aligned with 64 bits.

Please, see : <https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus-embedded-software/stm32h753zi-mdma-issue-with-linked-list-dma-adc/m-p/897390>

CubeMX : V6.17

Thanks,

best regards,

Laurent
